newsitem.title: CHINA: Fuji Electric sets up $30 mln ventures in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Electric sets up $30 mln ventures in Shanghai.

text.p: Fuji Electric Co Ltd has set up two joint ventures involving total investment of 3.6 billion yen ($30 million) to produce advanced electric circuit breakers and transformers, a company official said on Thursday.

Fuji holds a 60 percent stake in the joint ventures, Shanghai Fuji Electric Switchgear Co and Shanghai Fuji Electric Transformer Co, while the Shanghai Guangdian Electric Group has the remainder, the Guangdian official said.
He said the joint ventures, located in Fengxian County in Shanghai, would go into production in November this year.
Annual sales volume of Shanghai Fuji Electric Switchgear is expected to reach five billion yen within five years and that of Shanghai Fuji Electric Transformer two billion yen, the official said.
